Please indicate the degree to which you agree or disagree with each of the following statements:
Denialists
  1. Selfish interests are scheming to convince the public that global warming is a major threat.
Warmists
  1. Selfish interests are scheming to convince the public that global warming is *not* a major threat.
Possible responses range from Strongly agree (1) to Strongly disagree (9).
Source:
Van der Linden et al (2020)
